items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: We'll catch and play, we'll catch our band, we'll play it you see. And we'll see the other fella playing something good, right? Right, right, we'll catch it and we'll play it. You catch it from one another

ctx.x: Yeah. I sit down there looking at them, the first time I'd been close to him playing, you understand. I sit down there, and I was a lad, just start the playing. And I just sat there, I must be with my mouth open, and I must have swallowed all that dust. Yeah, it does smell like dust. Yeah, you know. And I did like that. You didn't get your breath. You did. I must have swallowed some dust down there. And so they went, afterwards they went crazy, you know. Did he play anything like your band playing? Who?
Did Golden, did he play in a similar style to your band, or?

Well, yes, they all played the same thing, like you don't shake, you don't get no kick, you know, such a thing. They used to play all that. All that stuff, we'll hear that fella play. We'll play, we'll catch and play, we'll catch our band, we'll play it you see. And we'll see the other fella playing something good, right? Right, right, we'll catch it and we'll play it. You catch it from one another, you understand.
